description_en: Queries the list of created filesets
description_zh: 查询已创建的Fileset列表信息
name: DescribeFilesets

parameters.help_en:
The file system ID.

CPFS: The ID must start with `cpfs-`, such as cpfs-099394bd928c****.

CPFS for Lingjun: The ID must start with `bmcpfs-`, such as bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64ya****.
This operation supports only CPFS file systems (with ID prefixes cpfs-* or bmcpfs-*). General-purpose NAS and Extreme NAS file systems are not supported
parameters.help_zh:
文件系统ID。

CPFS：必须以`cpfs-`开头，例如cpfs-099394bd928c****。

CPFS智算版：必须以`bmcpfs-`开头，例如bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64ya****。
本接口仅支持 CPFS 文件系统（ID 前缀 cpfs-* 或 bmcpfs-*），标准 NAS 及极速 NAS 文件系统不支持
parameters.name: file_system_id

fields.help_en:
The name of the filter key. Valid values:

FsetIds: filters by fileset ID.
FileSystemPath: filters by the path of the fileset in the CPFS file system.
Description: filters by the description of the fileset.
QuotaExists: filters by whether a quota exists.
Only CPFS for Lingjun 2.7.0 and later support filtering by the QuotaExists parameter
fields.help_zh:
筛选键的名称。取值：

FsetIds：根据Fileset ID筛选。
FileSystemPath：根据Fileset在CPFS文件系统中的路径筛选。
Description：根据Fileset的描述筛选。
QuotaExists: 根据Quota是否存在进行筛选。
仅CPFS智算版2.7.0及以上版本支持QuotaExists参数进行筛选
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the filter key. Wildcards are not supported for this parameter.

If Key is set to FsetIds, Value is set to a fileset ID. You can specify one or more fileset IDs, up to a maximum of 10. Separate multiple values with commas (,). Example: `fset-1902718ea0ae****` or `fset-1902718ea0ae****,fset-3212718ea0ae****`.
If Key is set to FileSystemPath, Value is set to the path or a partial path of the fileset in the CPFS file system. The value must be 2 to 1,024 characters in length and encoded in UTF-8.
If Key is set to Description, Value is set to the description or a partial description of the fileset.
If Key is set to QuotaExists, Value is set to true or false. If this parameter is left empty, all filesets are returned
fields.help_zh:
筛选键的值。该参数不支持通配符。

当Key取值为FsetIds时，Value取值为Fileset ID。可以是一个或一组Fileset ID，Fileset ID最多可设置10个，多个值使用英文逗号分隔。例如，`fset-1902718ea0ae****`或`fset-1902718ea0ae****,fset-3212718ea0ae****`。
当Key取值为FileSystemPath时，Value取值为Fileset在CPFS文件系统中的路径或路径的一部分。长度为2~1024个英文或中文字符。请您使用UTF-8编码。
当Key取值为Description时，Value取值为Fileset的描述或描述的一部分。
当Key取值为QuotaExists时，Value取值为true或false，不填写则返回所有的Fileset
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The filter key information for the filesets to query
parameters.name: filters

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If the return results are truncated, use NextToken to initiate a new request to retrieve the content after the truncation point
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用NextToken再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of results for each query.

Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
每次查询结果的个数。

取值范围：10~100。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The field used for sorting.

FileCountLimit: the quota file count limit.
SizeLimit: the quota capacity limit.
FileCountUsage: the file count usage.
SpaceUsage: the capacity usage
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段。

FileCountLimit：配额文件数量限制。
SizeLimit：配额容量限制。
FileCountUsage：文件数量使用量。
SpaceUsage：容量使用量
parameters.name: order_by_field

parameters.help_en:
The sort order.

asc (default): ascending order, which sorts results from smallest to largest.
desc: descending order, which sorts results from largest to smallest.
This field takes effect only when the OrderByField parameter is specified
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式。

asc（默认值）： 升序，指定排序按照从小到大的顺序进行。
desc：降序， 指定排序按照从大到小的顺序进行。
当填写OrderByField参数后，此字段生效
parameters.name: sort_order

CreateTime.description_en:
The time when the fileset was created.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`
CreateTime.description_zh:
Fileset的创建时间。

执行ISO8601标准表示，返回格式：`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`

DeletionProtection.description_en:
The release protection attribute that specifies whether the instance can be released from the console or by calling the [DeleteFileset]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2402263.html） operation.

true: Release protection is enabled.
false: Release protection is disabled.

This attribute only restricts manual release operations and does not apply to system-initiated release operations
DeletionProtection.description_zh:
实例释放保护属性，指定是否支持通过控制台或API（[DeleteFileset]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2402263.html））释放实例。

true：开启实例释放保护。
false：关闭实例释放保护。

该属性只能限制手动释放操作，对系统释放操作不生效

FileCountUsage.description_en:
The file count usage.
Only CPFS for Lingjun 2.7.0 and later support this parameter
FileCountUsage.description_zh:
文件数量使用量。
仅CPFS智算版2.7.0及以上版本支持此参数

FileSystemId.description_en:
The file system ID.

CPFS: The ID starts with `cpfs-`, such as cpfs-099394bd928c****.

CPFS for Lingjun: The ID starts with `bmcpfs-`, such as bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64ya****
FileSystemId.description_zh:
文件系统ID。

CPFS：必须以`cpfs-`开头，例如cpfs-099394bd928c****。

CPFS智算版：必须以`bmcpfs-`开头，例如bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64ya****

Quota.description_en:
The quota information.
Only CPFS for Lingjun 2.7.0 and later support this parameter
Quota.description_zh:
配额信息。
仅CPFS智算版2.7.0及以上版本支持此参数

FileCountLimit.description_en:
The quota file count limit. Valid values:

Minimum value: 10,000.

Maximum value: 10,000,000,000
FileCountLimit.description_zh:
配额文件数量限制。
取值范围：

最小值：10,000。

最大值：10,000,000,000

SizeLimit.description_en:
The quota capacity limit. Unit: bytes.

Minimum value: 10,737,418,240 (10 GiB).

Increment: 1,073,741,824 (1 GiB)

SpaceUsage.description_en:
The capacity usage. Unit: bytes.
Only CPFS for Lingjun 2.7.0 and later support this parameter
SpaceUsage.description_zh:
容量使用量。单位：Byte。
仅CPFS智算版2.7.0及以上版本支持此参数

Status.description_en:
The status of the fileset. Valid values:

CREATING: The fileset is being created.
CREATED: The fileset is created and running normally. 
RELEASING: The fileset is being released.
RELEASED: The fileset is deleted
Status.description_zh:
Fileset的状态。包括：

CREATING：正在创建Fileset。
CREATED：Fileset已创建完成，正常运行中。 
RELEASING：Fileset正在释放中。
RELEASED：Fileset已删除

UpdateTime.description_en:
The time when the fileset was last updated.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
UpdateTime.description_zh:
Fileset的最近一次更新时间。

执行ISO8601标准表示，返回格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

CPFS: The ID starts with `cpfs-`, such as cpfs-099394bd928c****.

CPFS for Lingjun: The ID starts with `bmcpfs-`, such as bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64ya****
FileSystemId.description_zh:
文件系统ID。

CPFS：必须以`cpfs-`开头，例如cpfs-099394bd928c****。
